headline: Cença Pizza Bar / IN arq+design
context: Located in downtown Curitiba , the design of Cença Pizza Bar repurposes a previously underutilized historic building into a vibrant, welcoming, and character-filled bar — an environment that invites people to linger, discover, and socialize.
